description: This file defines the ProjectAdmin entity class, which maps to the 'ohrm_project_admin' database table. It establishes relationships with Project and Employee entities, representing a many-to-one association for project administration assignments within the application.

classes.name: ProjectAdmin
classes.description: An Entity class representing the project administrator assignment, linking a Project to an Employee who administers it.

methods.name: ProjectAdmin (constructor)
methods.description: Default constructor (implicit); the class relies on property injection via Doctrine ORM.
